name: – Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga – Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote – Am 38/1
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: (18d) Building trust in disaster communication is critical to ensuring that public warnings are understood and acted upon and requires transparency, timeliness, consistency and inclusiveness in crisis communication as well as institutional coordination across all levels of governance and investment in community-level intermediaries. The deliberate or inadvertent dissemination of false or misleading information undermines public safety and effective disaster communication. Therefore measures to prevent, detect and counteract the spread of misinformation and disinformation in the context of disasters should be set up, in accordance with relevant Union programmes and strategies, including the European Democracy Action Plan, the Digital Services Act and the strengthened Code of Practice on Disinformation.
